newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon cuts American Home.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon cuts American Home.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers cut its rating Wednesday on American Home Products Corp to hold from buy.
-- Salomon also cut its 1997 earnings estimate to $3.30 a share from $3.40 a share, and the 1998 estimate to $3.80 from $3.90 a share.

-- American Home Products said Tuesday it would exercise an option to buy the 40 percent stake in Genetics Institute Inc that it did not already own for about $1 billion. The company said the deal will be dilutive by about $0.09 a share in 1997.
-- Salomon said "AHP appears to be paying $1 billion for additional net income of $20 million next year."
-- Salomon said American Home Products shares could drop one to two points on the basis of the dilution.
-- On the positive side, American Home Products will gain greater control of product flow and development and may see some cost savings through the deal.
-- American Home's shares gained 1/2 to 59-3/4 in afternoon trading.
